title: Best Bra (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products that appear in more than one source or are highlighted as top picks in a single source. Sources used: Tom’s Guide (2), Bustle (3), OutdoorGearLab (5), OutsideOnline (6).
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the provided excerpts, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a runner who needs a soft, supportive bra that stays in place during a long run. The On Performance Bra offers seamless construction, machine washability, and three color options, making it ideal for active wear. Its only drawback is its higher price compared to other sports bras.
